newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Stora says to lift fine paper price Sept.
newsitem.headline: Stora says to lift fine paper price Sept.

text.p: Swedish forestry group Stora said on Thursday that it would raise fine paper prices by about eight to 12 percent from September 1.
Stora Fine Paper's marketing director Tor Lofqvist said this was in line with other market players.
"Our opinion is that we should follow the market price increase that will happen from September 1," Lofqvist told Reuters.
"We have advised our large clients in the large markets (including Germany and Britain) about this proposed raise.
"The price increase will be in the range of about 150-200 (German) marks a tonne."
Currently fine paper prices are around 1,600-1,700 marks a tonne.
Lofqvist said an increase of eight to 12 percent would be in line with competitors.
On Wednesday Finnish forestry group UPM-Kymmene said it would raise fine paper prices by 8-12 percent on September 1, depending on the market and product.
